key_features: Super-Cardioid Polar Pattern: Isolates the main sound source while minimizing background noise, ideal for interviews and vlogs.
Wide Frequency Response: Covers 40-20,000Hz, capturing a full range of audio from deep bass to crisp highs.
High Sensitivity: -35dB±3dB at 1kHz, ensuring precise audio capture in various environments.
Dual Connectivity: Equipped with a 3.5mm TRS and TRRS connector, compatible with DSLRs, camcorders, and smartphones.
Built-in Shock Mount: Reduces handling noise and vibrations for improved audio quality.
Durable Design: Suitable for outdoor use, ensuring reliability and longevity.
